title: Trident of the Waves
summary: A +1 trident that drenches enemies and creates Water on a hit.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial Versatile trident, 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d6 + 1 one-handed or 1d8 + 1 two-handed Piercing, plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls. Thrown. Dippable.
fields.Rush Attack: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Rush up to 30 ft and hit the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. Attacks against it have Advantage. Help or damage clears it.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Hits against it add 2 Piercing or, in Honour Mode, 2 of the original damage type to any damage source. Healing clears it. Undead and Constructs are immune.
fields.Disarming Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Hit an armed target for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Strength save prevents the weapon drop, with damage retained. The action lists weapon-action DC and the dropped-weapon condition lists weapon-action DC +2. Natural weapons cannot drop.
fields.The Water Caller: A hit applies Wet for 3 turns and creates a permanent 7 ft radius Water surface. Throwing the trident does not create the surface.
fields.Wet: For 3 turns, Fire resistance, immunity to Burning and Wild Magic: Burning, and vulnerability to Cold and Lightning. Existing Cold or Lightning resistance is cancelled instead. Applying Wet to Chilled makes Frozen. Wet breaks normal Invisibility and strips weapon coatings.
fields.Cold damage: The ordinarily acquired version lacks the extra 1d4 Cold shown in game data.
fields.Acquisition: High Security Vault 4 at the Counting House.
